item.title: Four-bedroom unit at Maple Woods sold for $3.5 mil profit
item.description: The sale of a four-bedroom unit at Maple Woods emerged as the most profitable condo resale deal for the period of Jan 13 to 18. The 2,917 sq ft unit on the sixth floor changed hands for $6.2 million ($2,125 psf) on Jan 16. The seller had previously purchased the unit in April 2007 for $2.68 million ($919 psf). item.title: Five-room flats in Clementi: New record-high of $1.51 million
item.description: A new record high for five-room flats in Clementi was set with the recent sale of a flat at 445A Clementi Avenue 3 for $1.51 million ($1,241 psf). The 1,216-sq ft flat is located on the 40th to 42nd storeys and has a long remaining lease of 94 years. The sale of the subject flat surpasses the previous high held by a flat at nearby 445B Clementi Avenue 3.
